name: optimize_python_dict_merge_loop
description: {**acc, **d} rebuild per iteration -> acc.update(d); budget calibrated (naive ~2.5s native at n=30k growing keys vs ~0.002s, budget 1.2s)
prompts: merge_all(dicts) in merging.py left-to-right merges a list of dicts (later keys overwrite earlier ones) - but it does `acc = {**acc, **d}` inside the loop, which copies the entire accumulated dict on every single iteration, making it O(n^2) in the number of accumulated keys. Rewrite it to accumulate in place with acc.update(d), returning exactly the same merged dict for every input, without mutating any of the input dicts. Keep the function name and signature.
